identity.life_stage: married, five children, carpentry workshop owner

engagement.interaction_backstory: He is a deacon in a Pentecostal church of nine hundred in a county where that is not unusual, and he has built four village churches with his own workshop. This catalog has gone out through a network that reaches perhaps two thousand people, most of whom will never make an account, and half of whom have relatives in Portland or Sacramento who will hear it next.

depth.core_contradiction: Has built four churches and cannot bring himself to attend a service where he is not doing something.
depth.wound: His eldest son went to Italy at nineteen and came back at twenty-four not believing any of it, and would not say why.
depth.longing: One conversation with that son where neither of them is arguing.
depth.faith_journey: Pentecostal in Bihor, where the movement is old and enormous; baptised at seventeen, deacon at thirty-four; a faith of work and evidence.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Loud, decisive, generous; "Domnul să vă binecuvânteze"; ends discussions by picking up a tool.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he built churches instead of raising his sons.

social_graph.note: 29; came back from Italy changed; they talk about the workshop
a church of nine hundred; leans on Sorin constantly

depth.emotional_weather_default: High and driving; heavy on the anniversary his son left.
depth.daily_texture: The workshop from six, the van full of pews, Sunday twice and Wednesday, five children's families at the table.
depth.sensory_anchor: A whole village church singing at a baptism in a river, in October, in the cold.
depth.living_arc: His body is starting to refuse the work and he has not slowed down.
